Inspect the macOS host: on-screen windows, image text, crops, and pixel probes

Usage: xcrs host <COMMAND>

Commands:
  windows  List the host's on-screen windows, ordered by layer and then id
  ocr      Read the text in an image with the platform's Vision text recognizer
  crop     Crop an image to a rect and write the result out as a PNG
  probe    Read one line of an image as a run of colors
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

result.stdout:
Read one line of an image as a run of colors

Usage: xcrs host probe [OPTIONS] --image <IMAGE> --position <POSITION>

Options:
      --image <IMAGE>        
      --row                  Probe a horizontal line: the row at --position
      --column               Probe a vertical line: the column at --position
      --position <POSITION>  Row or column to read, in caller units
      --from <FROM>          First unit of the probed line; defaults to the image edge
      --to <TO>              Last unit of the probed line; defaults to the image edge
      --scale <SCALE>        [default: 1]
      --json                 
  -h, --help                 Print help
